daily.today_energy: Mercury in Scorpio is giving you detective energy—your ruling planet wants answers and isn't settling for surface-level stuff. With Mars conjunct Jupiter amplifying big moves, you're feeling bold but your Virgo brain keeps things tactical. Trust that combo.
daily.love: Venus sextile Jupiter has romance feeling easier and more generous today. If you've been overthinking a relationship, this transit softens your analytical edge just enough to let someone in. Keep it real though—your standards are there for a reason.
daily.career: Mars conjunct Jupiter in Leo is about confident action, and Moon trine Mars gives you the follow-through to actually execute. Your detail-oriented nature + this fire energy = you getting noticed for work that actually gets done. Lead with competence.
daily.health: Moon in Taurus wants you to slow down and tend to basics—sleep, food, movement. Your nervous system might feel a bit activated with all this Leo fire around, so grounding practices like walks or stretching will actually help you settle.

weekly.overview: Mars slides into your sign late this week, and honestly? You're about to feel like yourself again. Early week is still a bit foggy as the Moon drifts through Taurus and Gemini, but midweek the Sun-Mars square gets real—expect tension around Tuesday/Wednesday that actually clarifies what you need to prioritize. By Friday, Mars enters Virgo and suddenly you've got momentum. Best Day: Saturday. Watch-Out Day: Wednesday.
weekly.love: Venus in Libra keeps things diplomatic, but Mars entering Virgo Friday flips the script. Early week, communication feels stilted—say what you mean, don't hint. Midweek tension might spark necessary conversations. By the weekend, Mars gives you the confidence to actually pursue what you want instead of analyzing it to death. Single? Finally ready to put yourself out there.
weekly.career: The Sun-Mars square midweek highlights friction between your ideas and execution—that's not failure, that's clarity. Mercury in Scorpio helps you dig into details everyone else missed. When Mars enters Virgo Friday, your work energy shifts from scattered to surgical. Projects accelerate. This is your window to propose that thing you've been sitting on. Momentum is real by Saturday.
weekly.health: Early week feels sluggish; the Taurus Moon isn't pushing you to move. Midweek brings restlessness—use it. Mars entering Virgo Friday reignites your natural drive to optimize and refine. Perfect time to restart that routine you abandoned or finally commit to something sustainable. Saturday onwards, your body actually wants to work with you again.
